comments.author: OldManJohnson
comments.body_html:
This is a cool mod idea.

Just installed it to try it out.
---
EDIT : Mod works just fine, but I think it needs adjusting. I know there are settings in config, but only for how much per level .. not when or at what level. In the early game, this is fine. But in the 30+ level area, where I installed the mod, you’re bringing in so many meds/heals that you can’t really loot. 1-2 IFAKS no longer cut it and you if you’re looting, it’s to find as many meds as possible. I may have almost 1k HP, but if I can’t heal, I’m avoiding big fights as if I’m lvl 1 because I can’t heal/repair very much.

Suggestion : decrease the amount per level or change how often it increases.

comments.author: SphynxRose
comments.body_html: Is this compatible with Realism? If not is there a way to make it compatible?

comments.author: MNSTR
comments.body_html:
I have not tested with Realism but if you disable health changes in Realism I don’t see any reason it should interfere. If you are using the health changes with Realism this mod will likely not work.

Either way whichever mod loads last in the load order will take precedence over the other(s).
